recommendedExecutionLayers.requirement: Select every immutable leaf in inherited provenance and all current explicit legacy contracts; bind both actual final bundles.
Run all listed leaves independently rather than stopping after the first nonzero historical expectation.

The v213 engine adapter reaches these sources through disposable copies. Record unchanged assertion hashes and each prior fixture amendment; final behavior may supersede an old expected endpoint but may not be labeled passed.
All independent quote, prose, citation, drug, UI/native and spacing leaves, including leaves whose native proofs need refresh.
Definition/reader/style/identity tests plus inherited main/complex coverage; native and artifact-integrity leaves separately classified.
Run actual modular and complete files with no injected helpers and bind all nested test modules.
After exact source+fixture deduplication, every other still-applicable leaf assertion remains an execution obligation. A later filename alone is not proof of inclusion.

supersededExpectationReviewQueue.status: potential historical conflict, classify actual failing assertions individually
supersededExpectationReviewQueue.replacementRequirement: Native responsive rendering with custom-style preservation, all group/body bindings retained and current viewport tests.

supersededExpectationReviewQueue.status: explicitly retired UI, not a missing editing transformation
supersededExpectationReviewQueue.replacementRequirement: No injected section/lead launch buttons; supported code editor controls remain functional.

supersededExpectationReviewQueue.status: presentation expectations may be obsolete; genuine error detection remains required
supersededExpectationReviewQueue.replacementRequirement: Current grouped actionable findings; no hidden content-loss failures and no claiming a retired warning text passed.

supersededExpectationReviewQueue.status: historical pins describe their original files, not the candidate
supersededExpectationReviewQueue.replacementRequirement: Retarget only declared release addresses/labels; independently verify current exact runtime hashes and historical source immutability.

Each changed expectation needs the exact old source/old expected/new independent expected, primary proof and an executable replacement assertion. Retain historical failure as superseded, never pass by deleting assertion.

reportingRules: Run counts, unique source files, static assertion sites, executed assertions and distinct semantic cases are different quantities.
Exact source duplicates cannot be merged when runtime files, options or fixture data differ.
Version-address normalized AST equality is a candidate deduplication signal, not proof of equal fixtures or behavior.
An aggregate runner invoked without complete child receipts is incomplete.
Keep original failure receipts and report superseded expectations separately from regression failures.
No test may post, edit or authenticate on Wikipedia.
